title: CIA declassified Arc Light mission records, 18 June – 15 November 1965
citation: Appendix I, 'ARC LIGHT MISSIONS: 18 June 1965 – 15 November 1965' (CIA-RDP78S02149R000100060004-0) and Appendix IV, 'Analysis of ARC LIGHT Program by Target Zone' with Figure 1 strike map, 17 June – 15 November 1965 (CIA-RDP78S02149R000100060013-0). Approved for release 31 August 2001, CIA FOIA Electronic Reading Room.
notes: The complete B-52 strike record for the war's first five months: 1,153 sorties across 74 numbered missions, June to mid-November 1965, with every mission assigned a UTM grid square in Appendix IV. Tay Ninh Province, and Nui Ba Den with it, lies in square XT. Checked mission by mission on 2026-09-03: no B-52 strike fell in square XT between 21 July and 2 September 1965, and the missions flown in late August (23, 26, 27 and 28 August) all fell in other squares. It rules out a B-52 strike near the mountain in late August 1965. Strikes in XT resumed on 2 September and ran through the autumn. Mission 33, FAR STAR, 26–27 September 1965, is the strike Pacific Stars and Stripes reported on 29 September as the war's 33rd, 15 miles northeast of Tay Ninh City.
